qualifier: Hartnup and dicarboxylic aminoaciduria transporter defects
name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport, Hartnup and dicarboxylic aminoaciduria
rationale: All members concern amino acid carriers at the plasma membrane; unlike confusables (iminoglycinuria, cystinuria, peptide transport) the theme holds the acidic-amino-acid (dicarboxylic aminoaciduria), Hartnup/tryptophan and obesity-variant transporter entries.

name: Transcriptional control and restraint of myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members cover transcriptional programmes of myeloid progenitors, their proliferation and GM-CSF response, and negative regulation of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation, whereas confusables carry positive regulation, neutrophil maturation or monocyte trafficking.

name: Canonical Wnt signalling, AXIN stability and destruction complex
rationale: All members are canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signalling; the theme is set apart from confusables (DVL activation, receptor-level regulation) by AXIN degradation/stabilization and destruction-complex defects.

core: cAMP synthesis and protein kinase A activation
name: GPCR-driven cAMP synthesis and protein kinase A activation
rationale: Members describe GPCR/forskolin-stimulated cAMP production and PKA activation; confusables instead centre on CREB phosphorylation, calcium-stimulated cyclases or adenylate cyclase inhibition.

name: Vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members are vitamin K metabolism with gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors plus ascorbate metabolism and vitamin responses, distinguishing it from vitamin D, vitamin E/ubiquinol and oxygen-transport confusables.

name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members are G alpha z/i-mediated adenylate cyclase inhibition via alpha-2 adrenergic receptors with regulation of cyclase activity, unlike confusables centred on PKA activation, muscarinic/purinergic Gi receptors or catecholamine secretion.

name: RUNX2- and Wnt-regulated osteoblast and mesenchymal progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation via RUNX2, Wnt, BMP and osteocyte mechanosignalling, whereas confusables emphasise chondrocytes, osteoclasts or collagen/tendon.

name: Tyrosine, proline and glycine amino acid metabolism
rationale: All members are amino acid metabolic processes; tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism separates it from threonine/citrulline and organic-acid confusables, and proline/glycine/glyoxylate separate it from the phenylalanine confusable.

name: Ovarian follicle growth, oocyte maturation and luteolysis
rationale: Members span follicle growth, ovulation, oocyte maturation, luteinization, luteolysis and the estrous cycle, while confusables centre on gonadotropin secretion and response.

name: Linkage-specific ubiquitination, deubiquitination and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members are ubiquitin chain synthesis by linkage type, deubiquitinase families and proteasome assembly/degradation, distinguishing it from autophagy, ERAD/misfolded-protein and neddylation confusables.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium reuptake and ryanodine receptor restraint
rationale: Members regulate calcium pumping into the SR/ER, cytosolic calcium reduction and limitation of ryanodine-receptor release, whereas confusables carry cardiac rate/contraction or positive calcium release.

qualifier: Golgi-to-plasma membrane and cholesterol vesicle transport
name: Endocytic recycling, Golgi-to-plasma membrane and cholesterol vesicle transport
rationale: Members concern endosome-to-plasma membrane recycling plus Golgi-to-plasma membrane and vesicular cholesterol transport, unlike confusables with constitutive secretion, retrograde Golgi traffic or tubulation.

name: Fibronectin matrix, integrin focal adhesion and fibroblast migration
rationale: Members cover integrin synthesis, fibronectin matrix, focal adhesion assembly and SRF-driven fibroblast motility, while confusables emphasise MET/syndecan, collagen receptors or EMT.

qualifier: VEGF/Tie angiogenesis and smooth muscle phenotypic switching
name: VEGF/Tie angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching
rationale: Members combine VEGF/Tie-driven endothelial angiogenesis with vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching, unlike confusables lacking either arm or centred on leukocyte-endothelial adhesion.

qualifier: atrophy and inhibition of myoblast differentiation
name: Skeletal muscle atrophy and inhibition of myoblast differentiation
rationale: Members describe negative regulation of myogenesis, satellite cell maintenance and atrophy after inactivity, whereas confusables carry hypertrophy, positive myogenesis or contraction.

qualifier: both T and B cells, costimulation and co-inhibition
name: T and B cell receptor signalling, costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members span TCR and BCR proximal signalling with CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 inhibition; T-cell-only confusables lack the BCR arm and the B-cell confusable lacks the co-inhibition and PECAM1 entries.

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are embryonic morphogenesis of face, palate, nose, skull and limbs/digits, whereas confusables add pharyngeal organs or ossification without limbs.

qualifier: via ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptors
name: Platelet activation via ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptors
rationale: All members are platelet activation, aggregation and coagulation; the soluble-agonist GPCR routes distinguish it from integrin/Rap1 and GPIb/collagen-adhesion confusables.

core: Ryanodine receptor calcium release in heart
qualifier: restraining cardiac contraction and heart rate
name: Ryanodine calcium release restraining cardiac contraction and heart rate
rationale: Members regulate sequestered calcium release and its effects on cardiac contraction, relaxation and heart rate, distinguished from SERCA-reuptake and positive-inotropic confusables by negative rate/contraction control.

name: Endocytic recycling and constitutive secretion to plasma membrane
rationale: Members are endosome-to-plasma membrane recycling plus constitutive secretion and Golgi membrane localization, unlike confusables centred on Golgi-lysosome, retrograde or Rab/ARF traffic.

name: 3'-UTR mRNA stabilization, translational silencing and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability and translation with stress granule assembly, distinguished from confusables dominated by TTP/KSRP destabilization and decapping decay.

name: MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation and light response
rationale: Members are MITF-M target programmes, melanin synthesis, pigment granule localization and responses to UV/blue light, while confusables carry MITF-M cell-cycle, DNA-repair or melanosome-assembly entries.

name: Solute carrier transport of amino acids, oligopeptides and urate
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated plasma membrane transport and its renal disorders, with amino acid, peptide and urate carriers separating it from organic cation, hexose and cationic amino acid confusables.

qualifier: cation-chloride cotransport and osmotic stress response
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and cell volume response to osmotic stress
rationale: Members cover Na-K-Cl cotransporters and their tubulopathies, potassium channels and osmotic/salt stress responses, whereas confusables emphasise tight junctions, K2P channels, P-type ATPases or Na/H exchangers.

qualifier: lineage commitment and terminal red cell maturation
name: Erythroid lineage commitment and terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members describe erythroid commitment and late red cell membrane maturation, unlike confusables centred on haematopoietic stem cells or megakaryocytes.

qualifier: retinol uptake and retinoic acid synthesis
name: Retinol uptake and retinoic acid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are retinol/retinal/retinoic acid metabolism with STRA6-dependent uptake, distinguished from visual-cycle, retinoic-acid response and vitamin D confusables.

qualifier: nephric duct and nephron tubule morphogenesis
name: Nephric duct and nephron tubule morphogenesis
rationale: Members are nephric duct formation and metanephric nephron tubule patterning and segment differentiation, whereas confusables centre on ureteric bud formation and organ induction.

name: Non-coding RNA methylation and snRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members are methylation of rRNA, tRNA and snRNA caps with snoRNP/snRNP assembly and transport, distinguished from pseudouridylation and diphthamide confusables.

qualifier: capping against recombination and end joining
name: Telomere capping and protection from recombination and end joining
rationale: Members are telomere capping, packaging and suppression of recombination/NHEJ, while confusables concern telomere replication, D-loop handling or telomerase extension.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signalling, cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets
rationale: Members are TGF-beta/BMP/activin receptor-SMAD signalling and its regulation; receptor/SMAD cancer mutants, TGFBR3 and RUNX3 targets distinguish it from confusables.
